finding: The 4 parametrized cases never put the clashing moderator role in a pattern walked BEFORE the debate step's pattern. Mutants that survive on the add_moderator guard: (E) `self.taken(self.owner[MODERATOR], pattern, step)` changed to `self.taken(pattern, pattern, step)` (112 passed) and (G) `self.roles[MODERATOR] is not self.moderator` changed to `!=` (112 passed).
why: The 'own-role' case has owner == pattern, so it cannot tell the owner from the debate-step pattern. No case checks 'either include order' where the owner (q) differs from the debate-step pattern (r), nor a same-values earlier role (the identity-vs-equality check) on that path.
fix: Add a case with p including q then r: q has role moderator (role() and _same_as_added() variants) and r holds the debate step. Assert owner 'q' and step 'argue of pattern r'.
evidence: mutation probe on a copy at head 824fd86 (scripts/team/resolver.py:265-266): E and G left all 112 tests green. Test cases at lines 443-451 each have the debate step in p, the first-walked pattern.
